newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guthrie takes 20 pct of Ideal Pacific.
newsitem.headline: Guthrie takes 20 pct of Ideal Pacific.

text.p: Guthrie GTS Ltd's wholly-owned Transwin Hong Kong Ltd unit has agreed to buy 20 percent of Hong Kong sea freight transporter Ideal Pacific Holdings Ltd , Ideal Pacific said in a statement on Friday.

Ideal Pacific said Transwin would buy 58.60 million new shares of the company at HK$1.20 per share, and another 43.24 million existing shares from chairman and controlling shareholder Ip Man Man at HK$1.04 each.
On completion of the deal, Transwin will hold 20 percent of Ideal Pacific's enlarged share capital, while Ip's shareholding will be reduced to 51.46 percent from 67.75 percent.
Guthrie is the holding company of a group of companies engaged in mechnical and engineering contracting and property investment and development in Singapore.
"As we regionalise our operations in Asia, Guthrie fits into our strategy by providing the necessary connections in Singapore and the rest of the Southeast Asia," Ip said.
Transwin said the acquisition fits in with its parent's objective to develop logistics and distribution centre ownership and management in Asia as one of its core businesses, Ideal Pacific said.
